attributes.body: I bought the Aurora Desk Lamp for my home office. The light itself is pleasant, but at the lowest brightness step the panel flickers, which I notice within a few minutes of reading. At the higher steps it is fine. For the price I expected better, and I am returning it.
attributes.title: Flickers at the lowest setting

payload.verbatim: I bought the Aurora Desk Lamp for my home office. The light itself is pleasant, but at the lowest brightness step the panel flickers, which I notice within a few minutes of reading. At the higher steps it is fine. For the price I expected better, and I am returning it.

attributes.body: After two weeks of evenings at my desk the Aurora lamp has replaced my old halogen one completely. The warm setting is easy on the eyes and the USB-C port in the base keeps my phone charged. I plan to buy a second Aurora Desk Lamp for the bedroom.
